---
title: "no_version_path"
description: "There is no step in `versions` from a persisted version to the current one."
---

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mts from the website's docs. Do not edit: run `pnpm docs:gen`. -->

**What happened:** There is no step in `versions` from a persisted version to the current one.

**How to fix it:** Keep every version that may still be persisted in the chain, with a `state` step from its predecessor.

Thrown as an `ActorKitError` (or a subclass) whose `code` is this one and whose `docs` is this page.

The error's `message` names the specifics (the message, state, binding or value involved). See all [error codes](/errors/).
